source_evidence: Variable life insurance policies might offer other optional insurance benefits, for which you must pay extra. Optional features may also carry risks and limitations.
answer: Optional insurance riders are extra benefits that may be added to a variable life insurance policy for an additional cost. Examples include a disability rider, which can keep the policy in force if you become disabled and cannot pay policy charges, and an accelerated death benefit, which can pay part of the death benefit while you are alive if you are chronically or terminally ill. Riders can have risks or limitations, so understand their terms and consider whether you need the benefit and whether it may be available separately for less.
